title: Cooling system inspection
description: Quarterly inspection of the FX-400 coolant loop, radiator, and intake filter. Filter was serviceable. No work order opened for replacement.

title: Spindle lubrication PM
description: Scheduled spindle lubrication and way-cover check. No thermal findings recorded.

title: Seal and bearing inspection
description: Visual inspection of mechanical seal and bearing housing. Vibration within spec.

title: Belt tracking and idler lube
description: Belt tracking adjusted 4 mm. Idlers greased.

title: Hydraulic seal pack replacement
description: Replaced ram seal pack after slow pressure bleed-down. Press returned to service.

title: Intake filter replacement
description: Replaced air intake filter. Discharge temperature normal after change.
